body:
Scoped out-of-band review: RC-CUSTODY-INDEX-01 at f0e671acd513be3bfdb72e546d422839fdfbbf2e is accepted as a bounded engineering change. No new technical reconciliation HOLD is introduced.

Source review confirms the covering identity index is provisioned inside the existing owning schema transaction; query/authority/effect/retention semantics are unchanged. Independent inspection of retained raw evidence verifies 12 original lookup failures, 28 focused passes, all 415 cumulative cases including the prior 387 IDs, and the deletion mutant failing the same 12 lookup cases. Both earlier eight-failure constancy experiments remain preserved rather than being relabeled successful. The matched six-arm query-plan/VM-work results support the finite claim stated in the case record, not a general constant-time guarantee.

Coverage recomputes 245/260 (94.23%), 32 changed executable files, zero exclusions. Ledger checks verify 72 cumulative/147 RRCA rows, exact CSV/SQLite parity, intact 70/142 historical prefixes and matching hashes/integrity. This is source and producer-evidence review, not independent target execution.

Maintain the limits already recorded: no production latency, revocation-delay, resource, startup/migration, recovery or full-work-package qualification. Index creation costs under the write fence still require target qualification. Continue only previously authorized engineering under disposition 6432712455, with personal source/requirements/evidence verification and small scoped commits. Integration, merge and deployment remain unauthorized.
